stage: Phase B dense retrieval / local graph construction
selection: stratified random by question type from 498 ten-context questions

sparsification.method: retain strongest ceiling(50% of sentence-frequency edges)
sparsification.tie_break: descending weight then lexical endpoint IDs
sparsification.edges_retained: see per-question original/removed graph edge counts

entity_extraction.existing_mapping_provenance: mapping manifest does not record extractor/model revision; fresh passage-local sentence extraction is used for all graph construction

dense_model.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

global_model_data_sharing: passage embeddings are independently encoded from text; each graph, seed set, candidate pool, and ranking is built per question from its ten contexts

statistics.paired_test: two-sided paired sign-flip Monte Carlo randomization, plus-one correction
statistics.holm_family: all 69 prespecified baseline and direct graph-construction method/outcome contrasts in paired_comparisons.csv

runtime_semantics: efficiency.csv records one-time model load, passage/query encoding and total scope runtime; raw rows record graph build plus query retrieval split into scoring, candidate generation, reranking, and query_retrieval_seconds. Query retrieval starts from cached embeddings and excludes embedding and graph construction; local TF-IDF timing includes its per-question fit and ranking.
